reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The Clustermesh option `clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled` is now set to `true` by default", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default in the clustermesh apiserver unless explicitly disabled.
consequence.remediation: Set clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false explicitly during the upgrade to keep KVStoreMesh disabled.

proposed.statement: Helm value clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled now defaults to true (was false); set it to false explicitly to disable KVStoreMesh.
